act.name: Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989
act.source_name: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment / India Code
act.source_authority: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India
act.description: An Act to prevent the commission of offences of atrocities against the members of the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes.

sections.title: Punishment for Offences of Atrocities
sections.text: (1) Whoever, not being a member of a Scheduled Caste or a Scheduled Tribe,— (r) intentionally insults or intimidates with intent to humiliate a member of a Scheduled Caste or a Scheduled Tribe in any place within public view; (s) abuses any member of a Scheduled Caste or a Scheduled Tribe by caste name in any place within public view, shall be punishable with imprisonment for a term which shall not be less than six months but which may extend to five years and with fine.
sections.plain_language_summary: Intentionally insulting, abusing, or intimidating a member of SC/ST in public view by caste name is a non-bailable offence punishable by up to 5 years imprisonment.
sections.source_authority: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
